svg.title: Kuroshio 2024: model-axis-normal spans, monthly sample ranges and dated section maps
svg.desc: Three depth levels. All primary attempts retained, including unresolved cases. Monthly markers are median and bars the available daily sample range. Dated July maps show independently intersected normals and separate latitude cuts. Source fallback, velocity normal and ocean connectivity are not verified; these are not physical uncertainty intervals or footprints.

g.text: Primary tangent: ±14 km along the model axis. Three nominal depth levels; five fixed axis latitude gates.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', Arial, sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: Bars: monthly min–max of available daily model values; markers: median. These are sample ranges, not error bars or climatology.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', Arial, sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: Maps: coloured geodesic normals; grey dashed latitude cuts. Navy axis; purple dashed left edge; teal dotted right edge.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', Arial, sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: Axis normal is a geometric convention, not a verified instantaneous velocity normal. Ocean connectivity is not established by these lines.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', Arial, sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: Unflagged source fallback and 110 km smoothing remain. Tangent scales 7/14/28 km are method sensitivity; physical uncertainty stays unknown.
